Lemma
[Semiconcavity] ↗ def:semiconcave-function ↗ thm:hopf-lax-formula-derivation 1. ch3:3.3-lem-3\group Hamilton-Jacobi Equations

If $g(x+z)-2g(x)+g(x-z)\le C|z|^2$, then its Hopf--Lax evolution obeys \[ u(x+z,t)-2u(x,t)+u(x-z,t)\le C|z|^2. \]

Proof

\sketch Use the same minimizing point $y$ in the formulas for $u(x+z,t)$, $u(x,t)$, and $u(x-z,t)$. The Lagrangian terms cancel, leaving precisely the second difference of $g$ at $y$.

□
